reason: A billing dashboard plugin that aggregates session usage, estimates model costs, and presents provider balances, budgets, trends, and subscription data through a web UI.

summaries.zh: 一个从会话日志聚合用量并展示模型费用、预算、余额、趋势和订阅信息的计费仪表盘插件。
summaries.en: A billing dashboard plugin that aggregates session usage and displays model costs, budgets, balances, trends, and subscription information.

capabilities: Aggregates usage and cost data from persisted session logs
Displays billing dashboards, charts, budgets, balances, and subscription information
Fetches pricing, exchange-rate, balance, and model-status data from external services
Stores budget preferences in browser-local storage
Triggers browser notifications for budget overruns and low balances
